items.question: How much does a page cost?
items.answer: Nothing. Pages are free; {{brand.name}} only takes a fee on paid tickets and memberships sold through it.

items.question: Why is my club already listed?
items.answer: {{brand.name}} lists organisers from public sources so guests can find them. Claim the page and it’s yours to edit, or ask us to remove it.

items.question: How do I prove the page is mine?
items.answer: Sign in with your phone number, then add a code we give you to your Instagram or your Luma calendar. When we find it, the page is yours.

items.question: When do my events appear?
items.answer: When you publish them. Nothing you set up in {{brand.stores.hostAppName}} goes live until you do.

items.question: Can I show events I run on other sites?
items.answer: Yes. They appear on your page as tiles that link out to where people book them.

items.question: Where do I edit my page?
items.answer: In the {{brand.stores.hostAppName}} app, on iPhone, Android or iPad.

sections.title: About domains and pixels.

items.question: Can I use my own domain?
items.answer: Yes. Connect a domain or subdomain you own, like events.yourclub.example, and {{brand.name}} handles the certificate. Or embed your events on the website you already have.

items.question: Which tracking tools work?
items.answer: Meta Pixel and Google Analytics 4. Add the IDs in {{brand.stores.hostAppName}} and your page sends page views, event views, booking starts and purchases to your own accounts.

items.question: What do my pixels learn about guests?
items.answer: That someone visited, looked at an event or booked, with the ticket value, and only if they accepted marketing cookies. Never anything from profiles, applications or private answers.
